$comment: Round 1 (docs/round-1-contract.md §4): the built-in UI STRINGS every renderer shows — the copy no author writes (a Select's search placeholder, the calendar's month buttons, the copy button, the Pagination arrows' labels). Keys are the ids, values the English defaults. A renderer ships this table (generated into TS/Swift/Kotlin/Rust as STRING_IDS + STRING_DEFAULTS) and lets the HOST override any id per surface (`strings: {search: "Suchen…"}`); the catalog refers to an entry as `$string.<id>` in a prop default or a macro template (`$string.previous`), which the renderer resolves at bind time like a token. `{name}` placeholders are filled by the renderer (src/strings.ts formatString; a macro template uses `$fill` → the core `fill` function): a sentence is ONE id with placeholders, never concatenated fragments. Round 2 adds the names the renderers still hard-coded (`invalidValue` = a failed check without a message, `message` = the Composer field, `codeBlock` = an untitled CodeBlock, `dialog` = an untitled Dialog/Drawer, `table` = an uncaptioned Table, `carousel`/`slide` = the carousel's role descriptions, `resize` = a Resizable handle). EXP-1259 adds `closeTab` and `newTab` (the Tabs close glyph and + button). Append-only (round 1 dropped the unused fragment `of`). VAPP-162 adds the call buttons (`mute`, `unmute`, `speaker`, `speakerOff`, `endCall`), the Plan answers (`yes`, `no`), the MessageBubble delivery labels (`sending`, `sent`, `read`) and the QrScanner's `scanQrCode` + `cameraUnavailable`.
